blocks.text: LOS ANGELES, United States — The Philadelphia 76ers produced another double-digit comeback to defeat the Orlando Magic 121-116 and extend their lead at the top of the NBA Eastern Conference on Wednesday. Joel Embiid led the Sixers’ scoring with 26 points while V.J. Edgecombe produced a decisive 13-point fourth-quarter burst in a 24-point performance as Philadelphia improved to 13-3. LeBron James also weighed in with 22 points after the Sixers recovered from a 17-point first-quarter deficit to claw their way back and extend their winning streak to four games.
